title: Mileage Usage Charge on Cancelled Alignment Services & Plans Plans
content:
A usage charge is deducted from the refund of a cancelled Alignment Services & Plans plan for the miles the vehicle has run under the plan, measured from the plan's purchase odometer to the odometer of its latest alignment work order. It is worked out on its own and taken from the purchase price before the single rounding to the nearest cent, and the refund never falls below 0.00.

| Miles run under the plan | Usage charge |
|---|---|
| more than 2000 | 15.00 |
| at least 500 and no more than 2000 | 7.50 |
| below 500 | 0.00 |

**Boundaries (hypothetical odometers, purchase odometer 30000):** latest work order at 30499 → 499 miles → 0.00; at 30500 → 500 miles → 7.50; at 32000 → 2000 miles → 7.50; at 32001 → 2001 miles → 15.00. A plan whose only work order is the purchase-day alignment has run 0 miles under the plan.
